versions.content: On reception of request for DM55 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according Table 1 column “PGN (Hexadecimal)”) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall trigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC with parameter DTCTypeFilter set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE_AND_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE an d DTCOrigin set to definition from J1939DcmServiceOnlyDTCsMemoryDestinationRef.
